description: Three independent normalled switches, each choosing between two inputs and passing one of them to its output.

inputs.text: Reaches the output of its block only while the block's lower input has nothing patched into it.
Reaches the output of its block whenever a cable is in it, in place of the block's upper input.

outputs.text: Carries the block's lower input when that one is patched, and the block's upper input when it is not.

notes: sixteen channels pass through unchanged, and the channel count follows whichever input is in use.
